title: Pearson Edexcel International GCSE English Language A (4EA1/02) — Paper 2: Poetry and Prose Texts and Imaginative Writing

authority.file: MSR/EDEXCEL IGCSE English Language Component A/Edexcel IGCSE Spec A Language Paper 2/Edexcel IGCSE Language Paper 2 Spec A June 2024 MS.pdf
authority.why_this_source: The board's own published mark scheme. A full series is on disk for this paper (January 2019 through June 2024, including the (R) resits) — June 2024 is the most recent.
authority.note_on_tariffs: Neither section's total is printed in the mark scheme; both are the sum of two AO grids, so each is declared marks_from: components with the grid maxima quoted.

total.why: The mark scheme states no paper total. 60 = Section A 30 + Section B 30, cross-checked against language-paper-specs.json.

questions.note: One compulsory question on an anthology text, marked on two grids.

components.label: language_and_structure
components.note: ⚠️ The AO1 grid tops out at Level 4; only the AO2 grid has a Level 5. Do not assume a uniform five-level ladder across both.

questions.note: The candidate answers ONE of Questions 2, 3 or 4; all three are marked on the same pair of grids.

protocols_note: Section A is decomposed in assessment-section-a.md as our own teaching split — introduction out of 3, each body paragraph out of 7, conclusion out of 6 (3 + 3x7 + 6 = 30). That is a Sophicly structure, not a board one, so it carries no 'Assessment Sub-Protocol: Question 1' heading and check E cannot read it. ⭐ FOLLOW-UP WORTH DOING: a per-part check that a protocol's element marks SUM to the board tariff — PROTOCOL-QUESTION-STRUCTURE-MAP.md already records three Edexcel protocols where they do not (modern totals 36.5/37 against a stated 40; poetry's intro header says 3 but its breakdown sums to 2; unseen Q12 sums to 25 against a stated 20).
